params.1273: Given by Reldo in Varrock Palace's library for completing all Medium Tasks in Varrock.
params.1292: Varrock armour 2 and a magic lamp worth 5,000xp in a skill of your choice.
params.1274: The armour gains the following extra benefits:
params.1275: - Chance of smelting two bars at once up to mithril at Edgeville's furnace.
params.1276: - Chance of mining two ores at once up to mithril.
params.1277: - Further improved chance of receiving a skull sceptre piece in the Stronghold of Security.
params.1278: - Skull sceptres have additional charges if assembled while wearing the armour.
params.1279: Naff will sell up to 32 battlestaves a day.
